content: {"summary":"The August 2025 outage was caused by a missed pod restart during certificate renewal, leaving one edge‑gateway pod with an old cert that Envoy kept in memory.","likely_cause":"Manual pod deletion caused one pod not to be restarted after the secret was updated, so Envoy never reloaded the new certificate.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"One pod missed the renewal and kept the old certificate in memory for a month","evidence_ids":["INC-0023#1"],"quote":"Envoy reads the certificate only at start, so it kept the old one in memory for a month"},{"text":"The renewal note required restarting every pod, but the operator used kubectl delete pod instead of a rollout restart","evidence_ids":["INC-0023#1"],"quote":"The renewal note at the time said to restart every edge pod, and whoever did it used `kubectl delete pod`"},{"text":"The same pod was restarted twice while another pod (edge‑gateway‑01) was never restarted","evidence_ids":["INC-0023#1"],"quote":"the name at the top was the replacement created by the first delete, so that pod was restarted twice and the original pod behind edge-gateway-01 never was"},{"text":"The outage on 7 August 2025 lasted from 04:10 to 06:55 UTC","evidence_ids":["INC-0068#0"],"quote":"outage ran from 04:10 to 06:55 UTC on 7 August 2025"}],"next_checks":["Verify that all edge‑gateway pods are restarted automatically after a secret update (use rollout restart)","Add a post‑renewal check that each pod presents the new certificate via s_client","Monitor the full certificate chain, including intermediates, for expiry","Instrument Envoy to reload certificates without full pod restart if possible"]}
